currentPublishedArtifact.treeDigestNormalization: Exclude subscription-generated Content/.tools/bepinex/extract/**. Sort files by forward-slash relative path using StringComparer.Ordinal. Each row is lowercase file SHA-256, two spaces, then relative path. Join rows with LF and no final LF; hash UTF-8 without BOM using SHA-256.

publishedProductRollbackArchives.retention: Retain outside the source/distribution tree through every 0.5.5 product-wave rollback window; remove only through an explicit post-release retention decision.
publishedProductRollbackArchives.normalization: Rows follow catalogIds order. CatalogID|WorkshopID|PublishedVersion|FileCount|Bytes|TreeSha256|ArchiveSubdirectory. Join with LF; UTF-8; SHA-256.

retainedPublishedArtifactFreeze.normalization: Runtime row then PublishedProduct rows sorted by catalogId. Runtime: runtime|WorkshopID|PublishedVersion|n/a|FileCount|Bytes|TreeSha256. Product: CatalogID|WorkshopID|PublishedVersion|PublishedMinimumDTMApiVersion|FileCount|Bytes|TreeSha256. Join with LF, UTF-8, SHA-256.

publicIdentityPathFreeze.normalization: Runtime row freezes runtime identity, public artifact facts, frozen-record state, mutable-source state, immutable-archive state/location/override/bytes/SHA/payload/manifest/verification/retention. PublishedProduct rows sort by CatalogID and freeze all role/type/distribution/eligibility/maturity, UniqueID, WorkshopID, official folder, package/DLL, source/project/manifest paths, published version/minimum, config/save/content/legacy paths, extra legacy lanes, release lane, protected contract, and retained artifact fields. Mutable source/target versions and minimums are excluded and checked against current source separately. String arrays sort ordinal and join with comma; extra lanes use lane~path~enabledBy~state. Join rows with LF; UTF-8; SHA-256.

protectedBehaviorContractFreeze.normalization: Read UTF-8 text, normalize CRLF and CR to LF, trim trailing whitespace from the complete file, then SHA-256.

publicApiFreeze.normalization: For each Stability Matrix data row: Area|API / Contract|Status; preserve Markdown cell text, trim cells, join rows with LF, encode UTF-8, SHA-256.

publicApiFreeze.privateAbiConsistencyGate: Every Release auto-resolves the retained 0.5.2 baseline, AutoFishing DLL, eleven first-party consumers and four exact external consumer DLLs from the sibling retained-artifact authority. All three DTMAPI_RETAINED_* path variables may override that authority only when supplied together. Missing or incomplete inputs fail; a synthetic pass never substitutes for this mandatory real-binary consistency layer.
